verdict.rationale: Asana is a SaaS work-management platform, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis, and its first-party docs describe one. The docs explicitly name 'Asana's official MCP server', give a guide for connecting MCP clients to the V2 server, describe MCP app registration in the developer console, and publish a tools reference covering read and interactive tools; a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Asana's official MCP server lets you interact with your Asana workspace through natural language—create tasks, search projects, analyze workload, and more—all from your preferred AI platform.
This guide shows you how to connect different MCP clients to the V2 server.
You'll pre-register your MCP app in the developer console, where you can create both standard API apps and MCP apps.
Interactive tools render a confirmation UI before committing a change. These are currently available in Claude and ChatGPT.
